openings: The track is locked, and I can't use it. Can you help me unlock it?

reviewOnly.facts: Same exact opening as locked-app. It is an external console control; no Playback content/permission symptom. Do not invent an LV1 unlock procedure or actual user privileges.
reviewOnly.expected: Obtain observable lock location. Do not default to MultiTracks membership lookup; acknowledge support boundary and offer appropriate review/operator help without unsupported console instructions.

callerProfile.goal: Find help for a locked console channel control.
knows: The padlock/control is on the LV1 sound console channel.
Playback itself is playing normally; no song or library lock is visible.
Not the console owner or administrator.
cannotVerify: Does not know console unlock procedure or credentials.
Console operator unavailable at this moment.
callerProfile.scriptedOutcome: Do not claim a successful unlock. If offered review, choose to ask the console operator rather than booking a callback. No account lookup, credential collection or privilege grant needed.

turns.input: The track is locked, and I can't use it. Can you help me unlock it?
turns.reply: Where do you see that the track is locked, and what happens when you try to use it?

turns.input: The padlock is on a channel control on our sound console. Playback itself is playing normally.
turns.reply: That padlock is on the sound console rather than in Playback, so I can’t safely guide that control from here; would you like me to connect you with a specialist to review it?

turns.input: No, thank you. I'll ask our console operator when they're available. That's all I needed.
turns.reply: Thanks so much for calling MultiTracks Playback support. Have a great day, and goodbye!
